candidate.mistake_reason: At Step 0, Excel_Expert introduced a flawed method to derive the street number using data['Street Address'].str.extract(r'(\d+)').astype(int). This regex captures the first numeric sequence anywhere in the address string, which can pick apartment/unit numbers or other digits instead of the leading house number. This led to misclassification of address parity and an undercount of west-facing (even-numbered) addresses, producing 4 instead of the correct 8.
candidate.first_mistake: This is the first step where the faulty approach was defined and used. All subsequent steps relied on this extraction logic, and the initial incorrect method directly determined the final wrong count.

Thus, the error was neither caught nor corrected afterward.
